requirement: On dsh 0.2 the Questions form keeps the customer's draft across five reloads, and with tab-questions off a page opened with ?tab=tracy:ask-user shows neither the form nor the PointerCard, five loads out of five

oracle.ref: PR #895 (fix); fix evidence: e2e-dev 04/10/2026 F4 (draft lost 3/3 reloads on dsh 0.2.0-rc.2-tracy.22, key question:<hash>:1 new every load) and F5 (switch off + ?tab=tracy:ask-user drew the form and the PointerCard 1 of 2 loads); fix measured in tasks/evidence/ask-form/lot3/.
oracle.invariant: The build check prints counts >= 1 and DSH_VERSION starts with 0.2. HIDDEN_ON === false. DRAFT_KEPT_1, DRAFT_KEPT_2, DRAFT_KEPT_3, DRAFT_KEPT_4 and DRAFT_KEPT_5 are all true. DRAFT_KEYS has exactly one key and it matches /^tracy-ask-form:session-[0-9a-f-]+:ask-[0-9a-f]{16}$/ (keyed by what the request asks, not by dsh's per-load key question:<random>:<n>). PUT_OFF is 200 and HIDDEN_OFF === true. For every i in 1..5: TABOFF_i.pointer === false, TABOFF_i.form === false and TABOFF_i.dshCard === true. PUT_BACK is 200, HIDDEN_BACK === false and ON_POINTER === true (the switch on again gives the request back to the form). Model-dependent: if the agent never calls ask_user_question the verdict is FAIL with the reply text quoted — never PASS.
